title: Environment Sandbox lease, readiness, recovery, and late-resource cleanup
alt: Environment verifies current Projects authority, the exact Workspace PVC generation, and Cilium policy generation before dispatch. It records an owner-fenced lease and immutable provider request, then provisions and observes the exact agent-sandbox resources. ReadyForDispatch requires the same verified network generation and actual Pod/PVC/isolation evidence. A different provider result after release is stored in a separate durable cleanup record and released with its original provider fence without changing terminal lease evidence. Workspace retention is unchanged.
